templates.name: Go pprof profile index is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: The response matches the Go net/http/pprof profile index and advertises runtime profiles. The check does not request profile or trace data.
templates.remediation: Restrict pprof to localhost or an authenticated management network. Remove the public route if runtime profiling is not required.

templates.name: Spring Boot Actuator mappings endpoint is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: The response matches the Spring Boot Actuator mappings structure, which lists application request mappings. This confirms the management endpoint is reachable; review whether that information should be public.
templates.remediation: Disable the mappings endpoint or restrict Actuator endpoints to authenticated users and a trusted management network.

templates.name: Django technical 404 page indicates DEBUG mode is enabled
templates.evidence: The missing-route response contains Django's technical 404 diagnostics and explicitly reports DEBUG = True. The page can disclose URL patterns and request metadata.
templates.remediation: Set DEBUG=False in production and configure a standard 404 handler. Keep debug diagnostics available only in a development environment.

templates.name: OpenAPI specification is publicly reachable
templates.evidence: An unauthenticated GET to /openapi.json returned JSON containing OpenAPI specification markers. The response body is not included in the report; public API documentation may be intentional.
templates.remediation: Review whether the API specification is intended to be public. If it exposes internal routes, restrict access or publish a curated specification.
